name: GQA
tagline: Grouped-Query Attention: $n_h/4$ KV heads shared by query head groups; KV bytes reduced 4x.
formula: $$n_{kv} = \max(1, n_h / 4), \quad d_h = d_{model} / n_h \\ K, V \in \mathbb{R}^{B \times n_{kv} \times T \times d_h} \xrightarrow{\text{repeat\_interleave}(r)} \tilde{K}, \tilde{V} \in \mathbb{R}^{B \times n_h \times T \times d_h}, \quad r = n_h / n_{kv} \\ Y = \mathrm{SDPA}(Q, \tilde{K}, \tilde{V}, \text{causal})$$
diff_from_baseline: Ainslie et al. 2023 — "GQA: Training Generalized Multi-Query Transformer Models from Multi-Head Checkpoints". Standard middle ground between MHA and MQA used in LLaMA-2/3 and many modern LLMs.

name: MHA
tagline: Dense Multi-Head Attention control: one independent KV head per query head (no KV sharing).
formula: $$n_{kv} = n_h, \quad d_h = d_{model} / n_h \\ Y = \mathrm{SDPA}(Q, K, V, \text{causal}), \quad Q, K, V \in \mathbb{R}^{B \times n_h \times T \times d_h}$$

key_hyperparams.name: n_kv_head
key_hyperparams.role: one KV head per query head

diff_from_baseline: Vaswani et al. 2017 (NeurIPS) — "Attention is All You Need". Unreduced control matching standard GPT-style dense MHA. Maximum quality but largest KV cache.

name: MLA
tagline: Multi-Head Latent Attention (DeepSeek-V2): low-rank KV compression with decoupled rotary/non-rotary channels.
pseudocode:
1. Define ranks: $r_q = \min(d_{model}, 12 d_h)$, $r_{kv} = \max(16, d_h/2)$, rope dim $d_r \in [16, 64]$.
2. Q low-rank: $q = W_q^B(\mathrm{RMSNorm}(W_q^A x))$, split into $q_{nope} \in \mathbb{R}^{d_h}$ and $q_{rope} \in \mathbb{R}^{d_r}$.
3. KV compression: $[\tilde{kv}, k_{rope}] = W_{kv}^A(x)$, with $\tilde{kv} \in \mathbb{R}^{r_{kv}}$ and shared rope key $k_{rope} \in \mathbb{R}^{d_r}$ (MQA-style).
4. Up-project: $[k_{nope}, v] = W_{kv}^B(\mathrm{RMSNorm}(\tilde{kv}))$ for each of $n_h$ heads.
5. Apply RoPE on $q_{rope}, k_{rope}$; concatenate with nope channels.
6. $Y = \mathrm{SDPA}(q, k, v, \text{causal}, \text{scale}=1/\sqrt{d_h + d_r})$; project $W_o Y$.
diff_from_baseline: DeepSeek-V2 / TransMLA family. Latent-KV compression: cached KV is the low-rank latent ($r_{kv}$) plus a single shared rotary key, dramatically reducing KV bytes/token at preserved quality.

name: MQA
tagline: Multi-Query Attention: a single KV head shared by all query heads (KV bytes reduced $n_h\times$).
formula: $$n_{kv} = 1, \quad d_h = d_{model} / n_h \\ K, V \in \mathbb{R}^{B \times 1 \times T \times d_h} \xrightarrow{\text{expand to } n_h} \tilde{K}, \tilde{V} \\ Y = \mathrm{SDPA}(Q, \tilde{K}, \tilde{V}, \text{causal})$$
diff_from_baseline: Shazeer 2019 — "Fast Transformer Decoding: One Write-Head is All You Need". Most aggressive MHA-family KV reduction; trades quality for inference memory and bandwidth.
